scope: Backend PostgreSQL accounts, sessions, task checkpoints, idempotent requests, provider reservation ledger and daily quota
Async storage boundaries with SQLite compatibility for explicit offline regression
CAS state versions, worker fencing leases and heartbeat, shared per-account and global model slots
Redis atomic deployment-scoped authentication and AI windows with fail-closed behavior
Safe offline SQLite backup/import/rollback and local startup activation
observedCases: Two HTTP instances use the same tasks and Redis windows
Two actual server processes share PostgreSQL login sessions
Starting another instance leaves live-owner tasks running
Concurrent same-revision edits cannot overwrite one another
Concurrent repeated request IDs resolve to the original task
Final tool completion fences a still-running dispatch owner before observation handoff
Old-worker results cannot overwrite a cancellation or recovered state
Real SIGKILL retains a paid-call reservation as uncertain and requires explicit resume
User/global slots and durable daily usage prevent over-admission across instances
Redis failure returns a sanitized503 without memory fallback
Schema additions and changed target content block import rollback or reapply
Startup refuses the wrong storage mode and checks dependency readiness

intermediateIssuesRetained.issue: Async runtime conversion made the old restart fault check inspect the immediate accepted response instead of its persisted waiting state.
intermediateIssuesRetained.resolution: Keep the lease, budget and state assertions; await the actual asynchronous dispatch.

intermediateIssuesRetained.issue: Concurrent identical creates could be rejected as busy when the first commit landed between replay lookup and availability check.
intermediateIssuesRetained.resolution: Recheck persisted idempotency on the busy/revision-conflict paths.

intermediateIssuesRetained.issue: Final tool result could arrive before the previous dispatch worker released ownership, leaving observation unscheduled.
intermediateIssuesRetained.foundBy: Independent code review and controlled reproduction
intermediateIssuesRetained.resolution: Atomic phase transition and lease invalidation, then new-owner scheduling. Same-instance and cross-instance gated regression included.

intermediateIssuesRetained.issue: Rollback could ignore new target columns and delete data added after import.
intermediateIssuesRetained.resolution: Validate full business, coordination and import-ledger column sets before snapshot/import/rollback; preserve extended data by refusing.
